no_api_findings.finding: The documented built-in modules expose file, stream, and Buffer access but no PLY-aware mesh or point-cloud parser. Generic byte access is not counted.

no_api_findings.runtime: Browser File API and WebGL platform APIs
no_api_findings.finding: File and Blob APIs provide bytes, while WebGL accepts supplied geometry; neither documented API interprets an ASCII PLY header, vertex properties, or faces.

limit: This is an inventory of the documented Node.js 26.10.0 core modules and the cited browser platform APIs. It is not a proof about every host environment, native extension, or future runtime. No format-aware bundled PLY candidate was identified for a control probe.
